title: Tech Note: Web Services – An Introduction

historical_commentary.text: The SOAP/WSDL paradigm this note introduces has been broadly superseded industry-wide by simpler REST/JSON-based web APIs, and 4D itself later added native JSON and REST-friendly HTTP commands, so the specific technology emphasis is now dated even though the general concept of machine-to-machine integration remains as important as ever.
related_updates: REST/JSON APIs have become the dominant web integration style, largely displacing SOAP/WSDL industry-wide
4D added native JSON parsing/generation and modern HTTP client/server commands well after this note, reducing reliance on SOAP-style Web Services
